observed_by_parent: After first real HEVC decode exact, idle Executing decoder repeatedly logs LATENCY_SEM wait timeout; this agent performed source audit only

root_cause.behavior: 2ms semaphore wait; after more than50 consecutive failures logw on every failure, independent of bEnableLatencyStats
root_cause.semaphore: looper/omx_sem.c:69-101 uses milliseconds, CLOCK_REALTIME and normalized nanoseconds; no unit bug in audited source
root_cause.gst_state: Unmodified gst-omx PLAYING-to-PAUSED does not request OMX_StatePause

change.backend: cedar_idle: flush then Gst PAUSED then WC-v4 t736-set-idle(true); subsequent push resumes automatically
